In rare cases, some people may experience seizures when exposed to certain visual images, including flashing lights or patterns that may appear in video games.

Seizure-related symptoms that have not been previously detected may also occur during gameplay in people with no history of seizures.

If you or anyone in your family has a history of seizures or has experienced similar symptoms, consult a doctor before playing.

Stop playing immediately and consult a doctor before resuming if you experience dizziness, visual disturbances, eye or muscle twitching, confusion, loss of awareness, disorientation, loss of consciousness, convulsions, or any other involuntary movements.
